svg.title: CiteRAG architecture
svg.desc: An uploaded PDF is chunked (800 characters, 120 overlap). Chunks are embedded locally with bge-small into a FAISS inner-product index, and also stored in a BM25 corpus. A question searches both; the top 20 from each are fused with reciprocal rank fusion (k=60), reranked by a cross-encoder to the top 5, and passed to an OpenAI-compatible LLM, which returns a cited answer whose citation markers are validated against the retrieved sources.
